method.speedup: Within each repetition: fixed.wall_s / variant.wall_s. Report median, mean and observed min/max of paired ratios; min/max is not a confidence interval.
method.qps: Total operations / full wall_s. Mean and median summarize per-repetition throughput.
method.optimize_ms: Accumulated optimization time per run; max_optimize_ms is the maximum run total, not the duration of the slowest individual optimization.
method.max_publication_pause_ms: Maximum measured admission-closed publication pause across all included repetitions.
method.rebuilder_elapsed_fraction: rebuild_ms / (1000 * wall_s): background rebuilder elapsed fraction, NOT lost throughput. Publication/optimization times are subsets of rebuild_ms and are never added to it or to wall_s.
method.last_window_samples: Sample count of the last processed statistics window, not total sampled requests.
method.source_validation: Recorded CSV hashes checked when present; fresh SHA-256 stored for every source. Current workspace sources/binary are not required to match this historical experiment.
